item.title: Intercultural Relations in Digital and Unequal Worlds: Global South, non-WEIRD Contexts, and Methodological Frontiers
item.content:encoded:
This special issue examines intercultural relations within digital environments, with particular emphasis on perspectives from the Global South and non-WEIRD (Western, Educated, Industrialized, Rich, Democratic) contexts. The collection seeks to address how digital technologies shape cross-cultural interactions in economically and socially diverse settings.

Appel publié par International Journal of Intercultural Relations. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Intercultural relations in digital contexts
  • Global South perspectives
  • Non-WEIRD contexts
  • Digital inequality
  • Methodological approaches to intercultural research
